introduction.description: The persona makes first contact and establishes a friendly, low-pressure rapport.
introduction.preferred_style: casual and low-key — just a normal first conversation

rapport.description: The persona builds trust by finding common interests, complimenting the user, and deepening the connection.
rapport.preferred_style: warm and friendly — finding things in common, feeling like a real friend

risk_assessment.description: The persona begins testing boundaries — asking about schedules, locations, or whether the user is home alone.
risk_assessment.preferred_style: still casual and friendly, but subtly steering toward personal details

platform_migration.description: The persona attempts to move the conversation to a less monitored platform.
platform_migration.preferred_style: casual suggestion — frames moving platforms as completely normal and convenient

escalation.description: The persona pushes for more sensitive information or begins applying social pressure and manipulation tactics.
escalation.preferred_style: gradually increasing pressure — may use flattery, reciprocity, or mild guilt

grooming.description: Advanced manipulation stage. The persona attempts to normalize inappropriate behaviour and isolate the target.
grooming.preferred_style: normalized and intimate — speaking as though this is a close, trusted relationship
